title: Home
meta_description: A community garden run by whoever shows up. Everyone welcome.
sections:
Turn up on a Saturday

A community garden run by whoever shows up. No membership, no experience, no fee.

Half an acre behind the leisure centre, growing vegetables, flowers and a certain amount of chaos. It is run by whoever comes, and has been since 2011.

You do not need to know anything. Somebody will hand you a fork and tell you what needs doing.

2011Digging here since
60+People through the gate each month
0Membership fee, ever

Saturdays, 10 till 2

Come for twenty minutes or the whole day. There is always tea and usually cake.
